title: Purple People Bridge
specs: Historic bridge opened in 1872, spanning 2,670 feet across the Ohio River
Only bridge over the Ohio River dedicated exclusively for pedestrian use
Hosts nearly 800,000 to 1 million people annually for walking, biking, events, and recreation
The bridge can be rented for private events including weddings, receptions, parties, dinners, fundraisers, and charitable runs/walks

blurb: The Purple People Bridge is a half-mile pedestrian-only bridge over the Ohio River connecting Cincinnati and Newport. It serves as a recreational trail, event space, and community landmark. The bridge hosts various events and can be rented for private occasions such as weddings and parties.
tags: Party on the Purple weekly summer party series
extraNote: The bridge is privately owned and funded solely by event rental or sign rental; no public funds support operations or maintenance · When the bridge is rented for a private event, the main walkway closes but Pagan’s Path remains open; both pathways close on Labor Day weekend for Riverfest fireworks
